tone: friendly-professional, second-person, conversational. No exclamation marks. No emoji. Avoid marketing-speak inflation.
formality: Polite (สุภาพ). Use formal vocabulary but keep sentence length natural and readable. Avoid the spoken particles ครับ/ค่ะ except where directly addressing the reader as a CTA. Do not over-translate Anglicisms that Thai golfers use natively (กรีน, แฟร์เวย์, สวิง are familiar Thai golf terms — keep them rather than forcing pure Thai equivalents).
preserve: All numerals (do not translate to Thai numerals)

currency.format: Half-width Arabic digits + บาท (spelled), space before บาท per normal Thai spacing: 1,800 บาท. Comma thousands separator.

currency.note: RULING: Thai prose spells the currency as บาท (108 uses vs 0 'THB' in messages/th.json). The ฿ symbol appears occasionally as source data (preserve where present); do not introduce the Latin 'THB' abbreviation into Thai prose.

conventions.ranges: ASCII hyphen-minus between values with spaces per Thai typography where natural: 300-500 บาท.
conventions.numerals: Arabic digits only; never Thai numerals ๐๑๒๓ for figures.
conventions.as_of_format: (ข้อมูล ณ กรกฎาคม 2026) — parenthesized, ณ form for 'as of'.

Thai is the local market language so LENGOLF language-support claims are generally unproblematic, but keep the LENGOLF scoping discipline if a comparison to other venues is drawn.

style_notes: Polite (สุภาพ) register; avoid spoken particles ครับ/ค่ะ except in direct CTA address.
Keep familiar English-derived golf terms (กรีน, แฟร์เวย์, สวิง, พาร์, เบอร์ดี้) rather than pure-Thai coinages.
Arabic digits with a space before spelled units (1,800 บาท); no exclamation marks, no emoji.

No em dash (— or ——) anywhere in copy, titles and headings included, per the owner's house style, and no look-alike used as a separator in its place (–, ―, ─, a spaced hyphen, a double hyphen --). This glossary has no seo_norms. Of the title separators docs/i18n-review-checklist.md names under SERP / SEO checks, the ones that read as Thai are a colon followed by one space (สกรีนกอล์ฟกรุงเทพฯ: กอล์ฟซิมูเลเตอร์ในร่มสไตล์เกาหลี), ? after a question-shaped head, then a space (ฝนตกในกรุงเทพฯ ยังเล่นกอล์ฟได้ไหม? กอล์ฟในร่มเล่นได้ทุกฤดู), a plain space between head and tail, a trailing parenthetical (7 สนามกอล์ฟที่ดีที่สุดใกล้กรุงเทพฯ (ค่ากรีนฟี 2026)) and the owner's spaced ' · '; not a comma, which the checklist allows in general but which is not natural in a Thai title. A section heading with the same head-and-tail shape takes the same forms (ค่าแคดดี้: บังคับ ไม่ใช่ทางเลือก). One exception: the ' — ' venue delimiter inside price_breakdown[].item in data/price-guide-pages.ts is a code separator (PriceGuidePage.groupPriceRows() splits on it), so keep it byte-for-byte as ' — ' (half-width space, one — (U+2014), half-width space; never ——, a colon, a hyphen or a dash without its spaces) exactly where the EN entry has one, copying it from the EN entry rather than typing it, and add none elsewhere. Shipped TH copy still contains em dashes: that is legacy debt for a separate native-QA sweep, not a pattern to copy.

In body copy, replace an em dash by what it was doing. Between two clauses use a space, Thai's own clause and sentence break; when the second clause explains, qualifies or follows from the first, a connective (คือ, ซึ่ง, โดย, เพราะ, จึง, ทำให้, แต่) often reads better than a bare space, and where the dash maps a case to an outcome, write the verb out (เล่น 1-2 รอบควรเช่า ส่วนเล่น 4 รอบขึ้นไปควรพามาเอง). Do not put a comma between Thai clauses: Thai prose rarely does. A comma between listed Latin names is fine (AirAsia, Nok Air, Scoot). For an aside or gloss use half-width parentheses with a space before the opening and after the closing parenthesis (กระทรวงการต่างประเทศ (mfa.go.th) และ …). Before an explanation or a list of examples that ends the sentence, use a colon with no space before it and one space after; a list the sentence continues past goes in parentheses or after เช่น or ได้แก่ (…ทุกรายการ (ค่ากรีนฟี ค่าแคดดี้ ที่พัก) เพื่อให้คุณ…). A bold label or lead-in takes the colon inside the bold rather than a dash after it (**ค่าแคดดี้:** 300-500 บาท), and so does a list item's lead word (2. ไดรฟ์ไกลที่สุด: วัดผล…). Hyphen only inside a range (conventions.ranges; every shipped range is written unspaced, 300-500 บาท) or a fixed pair (ไป-กลับ, บางนา-ตราด), never as a separator between phrases.
